Started by taking 200mg orally, after 2 hours nothing had happened, at most I had the stimulation of the same dose of caffeine. So I made a line of 30mg and snorted it, hurt like hell so I administered another 100mg rectally as I was unable to feel the effects of the first two dosages after another 30 minutes still, took a line, remembered I have stomach problems, didn't hurt ad much, watched an anime and took another line. Another line. Another line. Another line. An...in out. Quickly went to my stash to get more,I had promised not to go over 500mg no matter what. Anyways I ended up having an experience quite similar to a low dose of MDMA and an overdose of amphetamine and I ended up taking 2 grams of the stuff.
